name: OSU-6162
summary: OSU-6162, also known as PNU-96391, is a compound which acts as a partial agonist at both dopamine D2 receptors and 5-HT2A receptors. It acts as a dopamine stabilizer in a similar manner to the closely related drug pridopidine, and has antipsychotic, anti-addictive and anti-Parkinsonian effects in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: OSU-6162, also known as PNU-96391, is a compound which acts as a partial agonist at both dopamine D2 receptors and 5-HT2A receptors. It acts as a dopamine stabilizer in a similar manner to the closely related drug pridopidine, and has antipsychotic, anti-addictive and anti-Parkinsonian effects in animal studies.

summaryZh: OSU-6162，也稱為PNU-96391，是一種含氮有機硫化合物，化學式C15H23NO2S，結構上與普利多匹定類似，區別在於OSU-6162為3-苯基哌啶結構，而PL-101為4-苯基哌啶結構。OSU-6162可作為多巴胺受體D2和5-HT2A受體的部分激動劑。

uses.en: It has been studied in research for Parkinson's disease, fatigue after stroke and alcohol dependence. It is not an approved medicine.
uses.zh: 它曾在帕金森氏症、中風後疲倦與酒精依賴的研究中被探討，目前並非核准藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它曾在帕金森氏症、中风后疲倦与酒精依赖的研究中被探讨，目前并非核准药物。

sideEffects.en: In trials it has been reported to cause mild nausea, dizziness and tiredness.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中已報告它會造成輕微的噁心、頭暈與疲倦。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中已报告它会造成轻微的恶心、头晕与疲倦。

fact.en: It is called a dopamine stabiliser: as a partial agonist it damps dopamine signalling where there is too much and lifts it where there is too little.
fact.zh: 它被稱為「多巴胺穩定劑」：作為部分促效劑，它在多巴胺訊號過強處予以抑制，在過弱處則予以提升。
fact.zhHans: 它被称为「多巴胺稳定剂」：作为部分促效剂，它在多巴胺信号过强处予以抑制，在过弱处则予以提升。
